Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 180 services in tech, data and analytics, non-financial risk and compliance to ING units worldwide. We started in 2015 as ING’s software development centre and have since grown into a global capability hub, continuously expanding our services and expertise. Today, more than 2,300 professionals design and deliver digital products for easier banking everywhere, working across key domains including: Tech Foundation and Channels​, Core Banking and Architecture​, Data and Analytics, Global Products and Technology Services, Payment and Settlement Services, Risk Services​ and Product and Operations. From engineers and data experts to risk specialists, product and operations professionals and beyond, our colleagues enjoy a flexible way of working and a collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things, one innovative solution at a time.
Discover ING Hubs RomaniaING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as INGs software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from Bucharest.Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionING Hubs Romania is looking for a strong developer who is technically passionate, solution-focused and able to design, develop, test, maintain and expand the functionalities of the Inside Business Portal that is used by corporate clients (operating in 40 countries) globally.With functionalities such as Service Requests or Client Insights, we aim to empower our colleagues to help clients better & faster with their requests. At the same time, we are focusing on increasing and improving our applications resilience when it comes to security, quality gates, monitoring, alerting and so on.Your day to dayEven if youll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our offices garden, your day will be quite similar when comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:Delivery and Improvements:Design and develop new features from scratch and improve existing ones.Do code reviews, write unit tests, make code refactoring and take care of technical debt.Align and discuss solutions directly with stakeholders.Work in an agile environment, based on a lot of research, collaboration and learn from failure way of working, with highly impactful deliveries.Have a direct impact on the business improvements through developing and being part of the strategic deliveries.Provide hands-on support to colleagues when investigating production issues/outages.What youll bring to the teamExperience: 5+ years of industry experience in IT (dev).Tech stack/ knowledge must have:Highly proficient development skills - core server-side JavaWork with SpringBoot and other Spring modules (web, data, security) or any other dependency injection framework.Have a focus on quality while working with Junit, Mokito, Power Mock, as well as BDD frameworks such as cucumber.Work with Oracle as a database. Experience in SQL and relational modeling.Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar tools + Confluence, Checkmarx, ServiceNow.Experience or affinity with IT Security concepts.Experience with the entire software development life cycle.Experience with building services from scratch and developing on top of existing components.Understanding of Continuous Delivery concepts. Interactions with tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, Maven.Use Linux as deployment environment.Nice to have:Experience with messaging technologies and protocols.Experience in optimizing software for performance.Flexibility in development technologies. Expected to work with different technologies and languages (Java, Python)Personal Competencies:Hands-on mentalityProactive behavior and perpetual energy and drive to improve performance.Ability to deliver without much supervision.Creative learning and thinking, passion for technology.Genuine team playerPassion for mentoring junior colleagues.Clear, concise and transparent communicator.Foreign languages: English (advanced spoken and written is a must)Education: Bachelors Degree (or higher) in, preferably, an IT related fieldIf you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
